# shadcx

> shadcn/ui reimagined as self-contained Web Components. No framework lock-in, no Tailwind CSS — just reusable components that work anywhere with a single `<script type="module">` tag.

Key design decisions:
- Each component is a standalone vanilla `HTMLElement` custom element with its own shadow DOM, CSS, and JS. No runtime framework dependency.
- Components use CSS custom properties (variables) from `theme.css` for styling. No build step needed by consumers.
- The docs app uses Lit for routing and layout, but components themselves do not use Lit.
- All components are auto-discovered at build time — no manual import lists to maintain.
- Component entries are emitted as individual CDN assets under `/assets/<component>.js`.
- Tests run with Vitest and enforce 80% global coverage across `src/lib/*.ts` during `pnpm build`.

## CDN Usage

Load a component in any HTML page:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/theme.css">
<script type="module" src="https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/badge.js"></script>

<shadcx-badge variant="secondary">New</shadcx-badge>
```

## Components

- [Badge](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/badge.js): Inline status label. Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link. Supports inline icons via `<svg data-icon="inline-start">` or `<svg data-icon="inline-end">`.
- [Button](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/button.js): Action trigger. Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link. Sizes: default, xs, sm, lg, icon, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-lg. Exposes `disabled` and `part="root"`.
- [Input](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/input.js): Text field with built-in validation styling. Supports `type`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `required`, `readonly`, `aria-invalid`.
- [Textarea](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/textarea.js): Multi-line form control with placeholder, value, rows, disabled, readonly, required, and aria-invalid support.
- [Card](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/card.js): Compound content container with header, title, description, action, content, and footer elements. Supports `size="sm"`.
- [Dropdown Menu](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/dropdown-menu.js): Compound action menu with trigger, content, labels, groups, items, checkboxes, radio groups, shortcuts, keyboard navigation, viewport-aware placement, and submenus.
- [Checkbox](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/checkbox.js): Toggle control with checked, indeterminate, disabled, and aria-invalid states. Dispatches `input`, `change`, and `checked-change` events.
- [Combobox](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/assets/combobox.js): Autocomplete dropdown with keyboard navigation, clear button, and multi-select chip support. Set `.items` array and `.value` string.

## CSS Variables (theme.css)

All components read from these custom properties:
- `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--card-foreground`
- `--popover`, `--popover-foreground`
- `--primary`, `--primary-foreground`
- `--secondary`, `--secondary-foreground`
- `--muted`, `--muted-foreground`
- `--accent`, `--accent-foreground`
- `--destructive`, `--destructive-foreground`
- `--border`, `--input`, `--ring`
- `--radius`, `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`
- `--chart-1` through `--chart-5`

## Theme Generator

Use the interactive [Theme Generator](https://dobrinyonkov.github.io/shadcx/#/theme-generator) to customize the variable set and export CSS for your project. The preview uses real shadcx components in a horizontally scrollable card grid similar to shadcn/create.

Dark-mode generation keeps dark foreground, border, muted, input, and background tokens stable while applying style presets, so shuffled themes remain readable.

## Testing

```bash
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

`pnpm build` runs TypeScript, Vitest with coverage, then Vite. Coverage thresholds are 80% for statements, branches, functions, and lines across component source files.
